content.short: Raenest gives African freelancers and businesses multi-currency accounts, Visa cards and stablecoin receipts.
content.description: Raenest, the company behind Geegpay, is an African fintech that helps freelancers, creators and businesses receive, hold and spend money globally. Its platform provides multi-currency accounts in USD, GBP, EUR and the USDC and USDT stablecoins, virtual and physical Visa cards, invoicing, money transfers and access to US stock investing. Headquartered in Texas with a strong base in Nigeria and Ghana, Raenest targets Africans earning from international clients on platforms like Upwork, Fiverr and Deel, along with more than 11,000 businesses. Backed by investors including QED and Techstars, it combines global accounts, cards and stablecoin receipts so users can get paid from abroad and convert to local currency.
